Author: krays; CombatReborn contributors (legacy UI)
Name: RSR Classic Panel
Punchline: Classic RSR controls and Lifestream's old travel overlay with current plugin updates.
Description: Restores RSR's 7.5.6.13 control panel and Lifestream's pre-badge travel overlay using the installed plugins' current logic. Lifestream replacement is ON by default and can be disabled in /rsrclassic config or with /rsrclassic lifestream off. Each integration works independently; keep the original plugins installed and updated. Requires Dalamud API 15. Future upstream changes may require an addon update.
Changelog: 0.2.1.0: fix Lifestream overlay repeatedly reappearing every second. Connection polling now recognizes the stable live plugin owner instead of comparing temporary wrappers. Closed overlays stay closed; real plugin reloads still reconnect. Checked against Lifestream 2.6.0.7.

Author: krays
Name: Keyboard Warrior
Punchline: Typing automation, interrupt priorities, and teammate stats for Keybound Brawler.
Description: Use /kw for typing controls, speed presets, target priorities, debuff handling, and teammate stats with score estimates. Start manually; Escape or /kw off stops typing. /kb remains an alias and /kblog opens the recorder.
Changelog: 0.2.4.0: Correct interrupt detection from the remaining break-hit counter; boss word type no longer makes Tankbuster outrank shields. Interrupts preempt low-HP finishing immediately. Typing is allowed during Cursed Gaze and Dynamic Sensory Jammer, with a fixed 1600 ms pause after resolution. Removed pause-time setting. Controls automatically appear and stay available throughout the minigame; collapse the title bar to minimize.
